page.layout: One printed page with one text column (left of the scan), set in roman with italics, with a running head above the column. Below the text there is one catchword at the right. The left margin is empty. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: minus inquit Cœli & terrę, per quem facta funt omnia, feruiuit indignis,roga-uit pro fæuientibus, & furentibus, quantò magis non debet dedignari homo, ex toto animo, & tota voluntate bona, cum tota dilectione feruire domino etiam malo ? quod autem dixi de domino & feruo, hoc intelligite de potestatibus & Regibus.Iulianus extitit infidelis Imperator, nomine extitit A-postata iniqu[?] Idololatra ? milites christiani feruicerunt Imperatori infideli,vbi veniebatur ad causam Christi, non agnoscebant nisi illum,qui in Cœlo erat: Quandò volebat,ut Idola colerent, ut thurificarent, præponebant illi Deum, quādo autem dicebat producite aciem, ite contra illam Gentem,statim obtemperabant, distinguebant dominum æternum, à Domino temporali, & tamen subditi erant propter dominum æternum, etiam Domino temporali.] Non intempestiuè hic adijcere liceret de Valentiniano Historiam ex Paulo Dia-cono in suis Additionibus ad Eutropium desumptam ; Hic igitur, cum Iuliano in-gressus est in Templum Fortunæ Mini-stris

page.notes: Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The word after "iniqu" is an abbreviation mark that I could not identify with certainty. The bracket after "temporali." is printed in the text. "quādo" is a doubtful reading. The catchword "stris" is printed at the right below the last line, completing "Mini-". The page is one column only, with no marginal notes.
